# Songs of Tagore, In Data (Swaralipi Corpus v0.2)

> An openly licensed, machine-readable corpus of Rabindrasangeet (Tagore song) notation. Thirty songs
> encoded from akarmatrik swaralipi — the Bengali notation system — into a symbolic JSON format
> that preserves swara, saptak, matra-fraction timing, taal cycles and Bengali lyric alignment.
> To our knowledge the first such dataset to exist under an open licence.

Compositions by Rabindranath Tagore (1861-1941), public domain in India since 2002.
Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT. Maintained by Indranil (Neel) Banerjee.

## What is in it
- 30 songs, 659 notated lines, 8,127 matra-cells, 10,042 note-units
- 20 taal families: ektaal 12, dadra 6, kaharba 8, tintal 16, khemta 6, teora 7, jhanp 10,
  jhampak 5, sasthi 6, kawwali 8, dhamar 14, surfank 10, chautal 12, ardha-jhanp 5,
  madhyaman 16, rupak 7, rupakra 8, arathheka 16, a 5-matra dadra setting, and talamukta
  (free rhythm, 2 songs)
- Includes the Indian national anthem (Jana Gana Mana) and two bhanga gaan built on Scots airs
- Derived MIDI and MusicXML; reference audio synthesized from the notation itself, not recorded
- Per-song provenance: witness archive, URL, retrieval date, confidence level
- 3 of 30 songs verified matra-by-matra against scans of the printed Swarabitan

## Notable findings
- পুরানো সেই দিনের কথা: 94.1% of its notes are the Bhupali pentatonic, the rest seven Ni and one
  Ma — matching the printed raga name "Mishra (mixed) Bhupali", measured before that name was known
- ভালোবেসে সখী is talamukta, not dadra: the printed page carries no taal header and no vibhag bars
- Across the corpus, Pa falls on sam (beat one) nearly twice as often as Sa (21.6% vs 12.1%) —
  a finding that held when the corpus grew from ten songs to thirty
- v0.2 decoded a missing swara: komal Re, absent from the original decode table
- v0.2 corrected a taal error by deferring to the notation: jhampak is 5 matras in
  Rabindrasangeet, not the 10 of Hindustani Jhaptaal
- sources/catalogue.json maps all 1,568 songs in the witness archive that carry notation
